description: agent-harness contract v1: validate_result accepts a result with usage_completeness "complete" even when a summary event has null units or an attempt has no summary event. Under "complete", every attempt must have exactly one summary event and every unit in it must be an integer; otherwise raise ContractError. "partial" and "unknown" keep their current rules. Keep the golden contract fixtures valid. Change src/agent_harness/ only.
